title: MacroCatalog
description: The v1 macros (03 §6.1): named, plain-language controls that drive several fx parameters at once. The instance is crates/bragi-dsp/macros.json.

$comment.description: Free-form provenance note carried by the source file.

MacroDefinition.description: One vibe slider: its identity, its two-word label and the parameters it drives.

label.description: The plain-language pair shown on the slider, e.g. "Dry ↔ Spacious".

MacroDrive.description: One fx parameter the macro drives. The curve's x values are the macro value and its y values are the parameter value.

param.description: A parameter name from the effect's catalogue entry.

curve.description: Piecewise-linear points, x strictly increasing from the macro range's min to its max and including x = 0 (the catalogue default).

mode.description: A fixed value for a discrete parameter of the same effect (e.g. filter mode 0 = low-pass).
